verificationNotes: All logical application tables were translated into a single disposable DynamoDB table with no stream; no human table was read or mutated.
Cognito/acting identity and routing transport were injected from the existing test fixture.
The archive step used a synthetic worker lease; full deletion eligibility, OTP, S3 and Cognito deletion were not exercised.
A PAID payable status was simulated only in the disposable fixture to verify expiry; no payout implementation or authorization was added.
Unaccepted-offer privacy cleanup and notification-lease guards have local unit coverage, not live application/Gateway coverage.
remainingBeforeActivation: Compare current deployed artifacts and CloudFormation ownership, keep all new financial gates OFF.
Deploy matching acceptance event, integration worker, notification sender and deletion/retention contracts together, with the Drivers API financial delegation preventing old completion counters.
Validate ByDue queue/index, schedule, actual Lambda role IAM, Gateway/Cognito and device behavior with non-human traffic before opening gates.
Provide authorized integration-review/replay workflow; do not manually replay money or overwrite a terminal outcome.
Approve compensation/return disputes and merchant payout/settlement contracts independently.
